text_block_list.text:
After school, while having a snack and 
chatting with K.S.Miracle...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo. You two, over here, over here~ 
Out of the blue, but how about some fancy 
sweets?

A whole row of sweets lined the table 
beside Nice Nature. From the looks of it, 
they were homemade.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Whoa... That's amazing. You made this?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I wasn't the only one who made it, 
you know~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well now. The shopping district uncle gave 
us a whole bunch of fruit, but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Sweets!! Captain, sweets would be 
wonderful, sir!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Sweets, is it? Leave the measuring to me.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Sweets! Yay! Turbo will help too! Let's 
make 'em together, everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"So yeah, Turbo turned the whole place 
into pure chaos. But it actually turned 
out fine and tasted good, so we've been 
handing it out to everyone."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, sounds like fun.
choice_data_list: Are you sure I can have this?
Are you sure I can have this?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Go right ahead. There are three types, so 
please feel free to take one of each~

"Strawberry daifuku, kiwi jelly, banana 
mousse..."

Since we'd already had a light meal, we 
decided to split the three between the two 
of us, but...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Wait. Both of them? Are you sure? ...Then 
at least let Trainer choose first."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Any of them is fine with me.
choice_data_list:
Then maybe I'll go with the banana 
mousse...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You like banana mousse too, 
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that makes me happy. I like it too. 
Actually, I have a bit of a memory 
attached to it—

With a childlike innocence, K.S. Miracle's 
voice bounces with excitement.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was hospitalized, they often 
served fruit mousse for snack time.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It was way simpler than the one Nature 
gave me, but I absolutely loved it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I especially loved the banana mousse. The 
sweetness spreading gently across your 
palate, the aroma...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
We'd gather together bringing mousse, 
saying it tastes even better when shared. 
Ahaha, that was so fun.

Watching KS Miracle reminisce about the 
past, I felt a gentle warmth spread 
through my heart.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh. I-I'm sorry! I mean, I do love it, 
but I didn't mean it like that, um...!

Of course, I understand what K.S. Miracle 
was trying to say. However, that is 
precisely why—
choice_data_list:
I just wanted you to eat something you 
like.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
This is quite a dilemma... Personally, I 
really want you to taste it, Trainer.

Both of us, at the same time— Laughing at 
the coincidence, I decide to make a 
proposal.
choice_data_list: Shall we split it in half?
Let's make it together next time.

text_block_list.text:
If we savor it together, we can share both 
the fun and the joy. Just like her 
cherished memories.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's do that.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
We can share our thoughts with each other, 
and then go thank Nature again—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It'd be nice if we could look back on this 
from time to time. Remembering how 
delicious that banana mousse we shared 
was.

I tell KS Miracle to eat today's portion, 
and suggest that we try making that 
nostalgic flavor from her memories 
together next time.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Together, you say?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
! ...Ahaha, you're right. Looks like this 
will be another unforgettable memory.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll ask for the recipe next time. And the 
secrets to making it delicious, too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, I'm looking forward to it.
